items.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Edge: A 2B Reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor
items.summary: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2B-class reasoning vision-language-action model that plans driving trajectories and explains them on DRIVE AGX Thor, at 160 to 190 ms pixel-to-trajectory latency. The post NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Edge: A 2B Reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google AI Previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for Large Tool Libraries
items.summary: Google launched Gemini API Tool Retrieval in preview. Agents keep a large tool library on standby and load each parameter schema only when needed, inside one Interactions API request. The post Google AI Previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for Large Tool Libraries appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels
items.summary: TensorLean, from Columbia University and CertiK, formally verifies production GPU kernels at the PTX level using Lean. It checked 149 kernel instances, proved 83 correct, and found 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM and more. The post A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac
items.summary: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter looped MoE transformer with 3.4B active parameters. It runs on a 32GB Mac or one DGX Spark and scores 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified. The post Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-Live-1.1 in the API. The full-duplex voice model improves multilingual accents and transcription, and a new standby mode bills idle WebRTC time at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05. The post OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index
items.summary: Baseten released bison-1 and groundhog-1, open-weight decision models built on Gemma 4. bison-1 scores 76 on the AA Decision Index v2.1, and both models support 128k context and image input. The post Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B Agentic Coding Model Trained With Reinforcement Learning Only
items.summary: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, an Apache 2.0 agentic coding model post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B with reinforcement learning only. It more than doubles Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 to 12.0 and runs on a single GPU. The post RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B Agentic Coding Model Trained With Reinforcement Learning Only appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints. Sigma denoises text in a learned 16-D embedding space, distills to few-step samplers, and decodes up to 4.20x faster than autoregressive decoding. The post NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meta FAIR Self-Improving Memory Hits 56.0 on Continual Learning Bench
items.summary: Meta FAIR’s Self-Improving Memory lets Kimi-K2.6 write its own LOAD and OFFLOAD memory prompts, then distills them into its weights. Optimized prompts score 56.0 versus 44.6 for the best hand-written harness on Continual Learning Bench. The post Meta FAIR Self-Improving Memory Hits 56.0 on Continual Learning Bench appeared first on MarkTechPost.
